description: ADO-EVENT, clone propagation: a sink ev on a client static recordset of K, a Clone, and a second sink evc on the clone; MoveNext and Move(2) on the clone, then MoveNext on the original, then Close of the clone. Asks whether a clone's moves raise events on the original's sink, whether the clone has its own connection point and what Close of a clone raises.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
